question: Gadadhar Chattopadhyay was the name of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is option '**2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ramakrishna was born **Gadadha****r Chattopadhyay** on **18 February 1836**. 
 
• His father name is **Khudiram Chattopadhyay** and mother name is **Chandramani Devi**.
 
• He belongs to **Brahmin family** hailed from **Kamarpukur **village in **Hoogly **district of **Bengal Presidency**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swami Prabhupada** – He is a scholar, a philosopher, a cultural ambassador, a religious leader, a spiritual teacher, a social critic, and a holy man. 
 
• **Sri Aurobindo**- Sri Aurobindo was born in **Calcutta** on **15 August 1872**.
 
• 
 
**Swami Vivekananda**-He is known for his pre-monastic life as **Narendra Nath Datta**, was born in an affluent family in **Kolkata** on **12 January 1863.**
